assumptions: Cases run against simulated project states: with Code map, Feature map, and onboarding plan.
The procedure runs within an isolated sandbox and generates starter files in an output Markdown report without writing to repository files or contacting external services.
effects: Writes reports/growth/starters/{run_id}.md in the project; makes no external network calls or repository modifications.
Never creates GitHub repositories, registers packages, or contacts template galleries.

cases.description: Standard run for a product with an API/SDK, targeting Next.js to build a turnkey starter.

inputs.use_case: Query vectors and return semantic search results in under 5 minutes.

cases.description: When Code map is absent, the workflow must emit a diagnostic report instructing the user to run product.code_map first.
When an unsupported framework is specified, the workflow marks status unsupported and refers to FRAMEWORKS.md.

rubric.question: Are the generated integration routes, credentials, and API calls grounded in the actual Code map rather than hallucinated methods?
Does the starter keep private credentials out of client-side bundles and provide safe placeholders in .env.example?
